title: Locked 1961-2025 state-consistent fast/slow and reservoir simulation

model.reservoir: Frozen R2 tau=180 day, inflow_response=0.25, drawdown_fraction=0

formal_period_rule.pet_bridge_fail: 1961-01-01 through 2024-12-31 formal, with 2025 kept in a separately labelled sensitivity product

reservoir_activation.before_activation: identity pass-through: disabled flag, zero storage and spill, controlled/total release exactly equal to inflow, and release source components close
reservoir_activation.active_after_start: start empty and fill only from modeled inflow

shared_reservoir_export_semantics: A disabled multi-arm reservoir is evaluated independently on each arm inside the frozen router to preserve exact parent arithmetic, but those disabled arm diagnostics are summed into one physical reservoir entity-day row before export. Enabled entity-day duplicates are forbidden.
required_states_and_fluxes: routed fast, slow, direct and total flow
reservoir storage and release age moments

numerical_gates.flow_component_closure: absolute error <= 1e-10 * max(1, abs(total_flow)) for every row
numerical_gates.reservoir_balance: water, each source tracer and age moment close at a scale-aware relative tolerance of 1e-10
numerical_gates.nonnegative: no flow or state below -1e-10 in its stored unit

forbidden: editing reservoir activation dates after output inspection
